title: Volume Reduction in the Posted Daily Rate for Bushels Brought to a Storage Agreement
content:
The bushels the member brings to the agreement earn a volume reduction in the posted daily rate under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements. The reduction is read from the bushels taken into store under that agreement over the last twelve months.

## Basis of the charge

Where eighteen thousand bushels or more were taken into store under the agreement in the last twelve months, the large volume reduction of 0.00015 for each bushel for each day is taken off the posted daily rate.

Where eight thousand bushels or more were taken in, the small volume reduction of 0.00008 for each bushel for each day, which is 0.008 of a cent, is taken off.

And otherwise no reduction is taken.

## The bands, with both sides of each threshold

| Bushels taken into store under the agreement in the last twelve months | Reduction taken off the posted daily rate |
| --- | --- |
| 18000 or more | 0.00015 |
| 8000 or more but under 18000 | 0.00008 |
| under 8000 | none |

The thresholds are read as at or above: 18000 bushels exactly earns the large reduction, and 8000 bushels exactly earns the small one. A member 1 bushel short of 18000 stands on the middle band, and a member 1 bushel short of 8000 earns no reduction.

## What is counted

What is counted is the bushels taken into store under this agreement, on the deposits the storage account shows, over the twelve months running back from the day the charge is worked out. Bushels standing in store from an earlier crop that came in before the window opened are not what the band reads; the band reads what came in during the window.

## Worked figures, on a hypothetical rate

Take a posted daily rate of 0.00200 for each bushel for each day.

**Deposits of 21400 bushels over the twelve months.** The large reduction of 0.00015 is taken off, leaving 0.00185.

**Deposits of 11000 bushels.** The small reduction of 0.00008 is taken off, leaving 0.00192.

**Deposits of 6500 bushels.** No reduction is taken, and the rate stands at 0.00200.
